entryContract.labelInvariant: A label or labelTemplate names one exact state. It never collapses compatibility into opening, journal persistence into portable-file publication, or local save into sync.

machinePolicies.tab: Opening, ready, stale and failed are view-instance states; never imply semantic project mutation from a tab action.
machinePolicies.tool: Preview is temporary, committing is not completed, and rejected means no project change was applied.
machinePolicies.selection: Selection identifies current interaction context; it does not grant permission or imply ownership.
machinePolicies.issue: Issue state belongs to review context and must not imply model validity or professional approval.
machinePolicies.long-task: Progress, pause, cancellation and partial-result wording must be backed by actual task telemetry.
machinePolicies.save: The persistence target must be named when ambiguity is possible.
machinePolicies.sync: Remote status is always independent of local save/journal status.
machinePolicies.workspace-open: Project ready requires a usable project context, not a compatible file.
machinePolicies.arqfs-safe-mode: Translate the underlying file condition before exposing read-only handling.
machinePolicies.file-flow: Compatibility, migration, staging, opening and opened project states are distinct. A read-only opened project is an opened project, and is never described as saved or editable.
machinePolicies.ai-proposal: Apply requires current base revision and no blocking validation errors.
machinePolicies.web-plan-journal-status: The web build's saveState union reports the local IndexedDB operation journal for its own plan document. A label here never implies that a portable .arq file was written, that a user project was opened, or that anything was synced. When a native .arq project is open the shell reports the `save` machine's read-only state instead of any of these.

workspace-open.label: Opening project
workspace-open.explain: The project is being loaded. Do not present the editor as ready yet.

workspace-open.label: Project ready
workspace-open.explain: Project is open for its allowed operations. Usually no success toast is needed.

workspace-open.label: Offline · project available locally
workspace-open.explain: Network is unavailable but the local project remains usable.

workspace-open.label: Read-only
workspace-open.explain: The project can be inspected but current session/build/permission does not allow edits.

workspace-open.label: Recovery required
workspace-open.explain: ARQ detected a recoverable interrupted/local state that requires explicit recovery handling.

workspace-open.label: Project could not be opened
workspace-open.explain: The project cannot enter a usable workspace. Give reason and safe next actions.

tab.label: View needs refresh
tab.explain: The view is older than the current project state and must not be presented as current.

tool.label: {tool} active
tool.explain: The tool is active but has not committed a project change.

tool.label: Previewing {tool}
tool.explain: Preview is temporary and not canonical project data.

tool.label: {result}
tool.explain: Prefer the exact result over a generic Complete label.

tool.label: Change not applied
tool.explain: Follow with the validation reason and next action.

tool.label: Cancelled
tool.explain: Use only when cancellation itself needs confirmation.

save.label: Saved locally
save.explain: Current committed local state has been persisted to the local persistence target.

save.label: Saving locally…
save.explain: A local persistence write is in progress.

save.label: Local save failed
save.explain: Current changes may not be durably persisted locally. Never describe this as a sync error.

save.label: Read-only · nothing to save
save.explain: The open project is inspected, not authored: this build performs no local save for it, and the file it was opened from is unchanged. Never present this as a completed save, and never as a failure.

sync.label: Offline
sync.explain: Remote sync cannot run. Pair with local-save state when data safety matters.

sync.label: Changes queued for sync
sync.explain: Local changes are waiting for remote sync.

sync.label: Synced
sync.explain: Remote synchronisation is current for the relevant revision.

sync.label: Sync conflict
sync.explain: Local/remote operations or revisions require explicit resolution.

sync.label: Sync failed
sync.explain: Remote synchronisation failed; state local-save status separately.

selection.label: Selected by another collaborator
selection.explain: Use only when collaboration is actually current and identity disclosure is permitted.

issue.label: Context changed
issue.explain: Issue anchor/context is stale relative to current project state.

ai-proposal.label: Proposal is stale
ai-proposal.explain: Project revision changed since proposal generation.

arqfs-safe-mode.label: Project file cannot be opened
arqfs-safe-mode.explain: File cannot be read as a supported ARQ project. Diagnostics should state the specific reason.

arqfs-safe-mode.label: Project file failed integrity checks
arqfs-safe-mode.explain: Do not open as a normal writable project.

arqfs-safe-mode.label: Previous write was interrupted
arqfs-safe-mode.explain: Offer read-only/recovery actions supported by the implementation.

arqfs-safe-mode.label: Open read-only
arqfs-safe-mode.explain: This build can read the project but cannot safely write its format.

arqfs-safe-mode.label: Project data is incomplete
arqfs-safe-mode.explain: Required project entries are missing; open read-only only if the safe-mode plan allows it.

arqfs-safe-mode.label: Open read-only
arqfs-safe-mode.explain: A compatibility condition requires read-only handling.

arqfs-safe-mode.label: Compatible project
arqfs-safe-mode.explain: Compatibility is not the same as a live project being loaded.

file-flow.explain: Do not say opened until the live project pipeline has actually loaded it.
A project session is being created. The project is not open until every open check has passed; do not present the workspace as showing it yet.

A real project session exists and the workspace is showing that project. Editing and saving are unavailable, and the file the project was opened from is unchanged. Never describe this state as saved, editable or published.

file-flow.labelTemplate: {name} needs conversion before it can be opened

web-plan-journal-status.label: No project open
web-plan-journal-status.explain: No user project has been opened. The demo plan context is not a portable project and must not be described as one.

web-plan-journal-status.label: Saving locally…
web-plan-journal-status.explain: An append to the local operation journal is in progress. It is not a portable .arq write and not a sync.

web-plan-journal-status.label: Saved locally
web-plan-journal-status.explain: The local operation journal reports ready. The portable .arq file on disk is unchanged.

web-plan-journal-status.label: Unsaved changes
web-plan-journal-status.explain: The local journal is unavailable or a journal write failed, so current edits may not be persisted. Name the journal condition in the status detail; never present this as a sync error.

web-plan-journal-status.label: Recovered locally
web-plan-journal-status.explain: State was replayed from the local operation journal on start-up. State what was recovered; nothing was read from or written to a portable .arq file.
